info.title: StockMate API
info.description: Proposed single-warehouse API, not implemented. Business rules: docs/BUSINESS_RULES.md (2026-11-02). Bearer authentication and active user required; x-roles are enforced by backend, not OpenAPI scopes. Input objects reject unknown fields. Idempotency-Key is an optional proposed retry mechanism. Version checks and server-owned identity protect updates; technical details can be refined during implementation. Quantity integers in fixed product units; money integer VND; demand/ROP decimal six places. Calculations use last 30 completed Asia/Saigon calendar days and position <= ROP. Position signed. Missing data is not zero. Drafts may be incomplete/over-budget; submission may not. Proposal can combine products and suppliers chosen by the Planner. No shared budget or automatic quantity reduction. AI can only create/edit drafts. Approval does not place orders. Partial receipts/fulfilments/cancellations tracked. Read responses use current source or frozen submitted snapshot as documented; GET never mutates. List pagination page starts at 1, page_size 20/max100; empty list returns200. Timestamps RFC3339 offsets, business dates Asia/Saigon. Source reads/aggregate changes must use consistent locking/versioning. Errors have code/message and optional fields. Username/password login, revocable sessions and ADMIN account administration are specified here. ADMIN has no business permissions by default. All operations except login require active users and valid sessions; must_change_password limits access to identity/logout/password-change endpoints. Passwords must be hashed by the backend and never returned.
